title: EvidenceBinding
description: The link from a published value to the bytes it came from. What makes 'our figures are traceable' an enforced property rather than a convention (ADR-0012).

measurement_key.description: What a rendering component accepts. There is deliberately no `value` field: a component cannot be passed a number, so a number cannot reach a page without existing in an artifact first.

artifact.description: Repository-relative path of the artifact the value was read from.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into that artifact. Empty string is the whole document.

artifact_digest.description: Digest of the exact bytes read. The gate re-reads the artifact and compares; drift fails the build.
